args.sql:
SELECT c.id AS id, c.name AS name, SUM(o.total) AS total
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
ORDER BY total DESC
LIMIT 6
